shots.speaker: BIRIBEL
shots.text:
Three days. Maybe four.
Hard to count with the lights.

shots.speaker: BIRIBEL
shots.text:
Wrists raw. Chair bolted down.
They were ready for me before I woke up.

shots.speaker: BALACEANU
shots.text:
You told them I was a coward, Biribel.
A fake.
Tonight I tell the nation what you are.

shots.speaker: SYSTEM
shots.text:
STATE ADDRESS, LIVE TONIGHT, 22:00
SUBJECT: ROUTE 12 PERPETRATOR

shots.speaker: BALACEANU
shots.text:
When the address ends, so do you.
That is not a threat.
That is a schedule.
